name: yf_earnings_history
description:
Last four quarters of reported versus estimated EPS for one company from Yahoo Finance (yfinance earnings_history).
Returns: {symbol, earnings: [{quarter, epsActual, epsEstimate, epsDifference, surprisePercent}]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T).
Longer history with announcement dates: yf_earnings_dates or av_earnings; next date: yf_calendar. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
